note: Week 10 manager roasts from the Sunday afternoon board. The point fields were updated to the Nov 16 11:58 PM ET scoreboard so the cards stay attached. Lines that described a starter who had not played, including Monday, were corrected. The week is not final, so this is not a new closed-week roast.

matchups.headline: Jahmyr vs Sandusky
matchups.roast:
Jahmyr, the whole bit is Gibbs, and Gibbs had the day. His game is over. So is the rest of your lineup. You carry that lead with nobody left to play.
Sandusky, Burrow's night is over. Jefferson, Taylor, and Cook were the plan, and the night game did not cover them. Your lineup is done, and you are still the one behind.
matchups.tag: Gibbs had the day, and both lineups are done.

matchups.headline: Kyle vs Kabul FC
matchups.roast:
Kyle, you are in first, and you still sat Jayden Daniels. His game ended Thursday. You went with Lawrence. Ja'Marr Chase had the night game. Both lineups are done, and you are the one behind.
Kabul FC, Purdy already played. The week is not final, and you are ahead of the team in first.
matchups.tag: Kyle sat the quarterback whose game ended Thursday.

matchups.headline: Smert vs Easy Peasy
matchups.roast:
Smert, you are in last, and you started Woody Marks, who is Doubtful. He got you a little. Dak and CeeDee carried the week, and the defense you grabbed Sunday showed up. Your lineup is done. Henry played Monday, and Easy Peasy edged you.
Easy Peasy, you left Diggs on the bench. His Thursday game is over. Parker Washington outscored him. Henry played, and both lineups are done.
matchups.tag: Henry played, and Easy Peasy edged Smert.

matchups.headline: Gerrit vs All Heart
matchups.roast:
Gerrit, you built the week around Drake Maye. His game is over, and he spent it watching a blowout. Thursday already did your job. Your lineup is done, and you are the one behind.
All Heart, CMC had the day, and Chase Brown had one too. Mahomes did his part. Ravens D/ST played, and your lineup is done. You are the one ahead.
matchups.tag: Gerrit is done, and the quarterback he built the week around did not show up.

matchups.headline: Chewy vs Dimes
matchups.roast:
Dimes, you sat Goff for Bryce Young. Goff is done. Young did not bail you out. George Pickens had the day on your bench. Zay Flowers played, and your lineup is done.
Chewy, your lineup is done. Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Emmett Johnson showed up, and the Vikings defense came with them.
matchups.tag: Dimes sat the quarterback whose game is already over.
